scope: Content-free comparison of preserved 60K Pi-prefix round metadata and kernel/JIT diagnostics. Prompt and response text were not read or published.

jit_diagnostics.event: Triton kernel JIT compilation during inference

conclusion.explanation: The slow-to-normal transition is a one-time compilation event on the real request path, not evidence that the steady-state kernel permanently changed speed. The heavyweight profiler also perturbs the observed run.
conclusion.required_fix: Warm every admitted speculative decode shape before readiness, or fail readiness when JIT compilation is observed during the readiness request.

limits: This diagnoses the preserved slow-to-normal transition; it does not prove that every remaining HIP/ROCr queue issue is fixed.
The raw profile remains useful for attribution but must not be used as production throughput or as the source of row 26.
No live backend was modified or restarted by this content-free diagnosis.
